objective: Workout plan → exercise detail → Start exercise opens Module 5 mode selection

actual: Not executed. Appium could not create a session on the Redmi Note 11: during its standard start-up the UiAutomator2 driver runs "settings put global hidden_api_policy 1", and MIUI refused it (SecurityException: requires WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS; MIUI "USB debugging (Security settings)" is off).
